Definition: from G4862 and G1453; to rouse (from death) in company with, i.e. (figuratively) to revivify (spirtually) in resemblance to:--raise up together, rise with.
BiblicalUsage: God has raised us up together and made us sit together in heavenly places in Christ Jesus, and Paul says we are buried with Him in baptism, wherein also we are risen with Him through faith in the working of God. If we are risen with Christ, he says, we are to seek the things above, where Christ sits at God's right hand. The raising is not a metaphor for feeling better but a sharing in His resurrection, already true and already seated.
TheologicalSignificance: What grips me is that I was raised with Christ and seated with Him, and I hold that this is not a hope for later but a fact for now. My position is that a risen life must look upward, because that is where my life is.
